reason: The official Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap–Local Building feature is a materially different source family from the repeated HM Land Registry title/INSPIRE access paths. It supplies polygon semantics for a generalised building, not a land parcel or title extent. Under the fixed Height Difference contract, a building footprint cannot be substituted for canonical parcel geometry. No target-specific canonical parcel binding exists in the verified lineage, so accepted/materialized/direct parcel counts remain zero and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
